value.body: A two-year bachelor's degree for nurses who already hold a GNM diploma and are registered with a State Nursing Council. It builds on GNM training with more nursing science, community health, research and management, and gives a B.Sc-level nursing qualification. Programmes are recognised by the Indian Nursing Council (INC).

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A GNM diploma and registration as a nurse and midwife with a State Nursing Council. Some institutions accept other diplomas, so check the notice. Admission is through university or state entrance tests or a merit list.

value.title: At a glance
items: Seats are few compared with the number of GNM nurses each year.
It opens posts and courses that ask for a nursing degree, including M.Sc Nursing.
Post Basic B.Sc holders are reported to be exempt from the two-year experience rule for AIIMS NORCET.
